title: Выделительные конструкции: It was… that…, What I need is…

why: В русском мы выделяем главное интонацией или словами «именно», «как раз», «всё, что мне нужно, — это...». В английском интонации мало, поэтому порядок слов перестраивают: Именно Анна починила принтер = It was Anna who fixed the printer. Такие предложения называются cleft sentences («расщеплённые»).
formation: 1. It + be + выделяемая часть + that / who + остальное предложение:
• It was Tom who broke the printer. (Именно Том сломал принтер.)
• It was in 2019 that I started coding. (Именно в 2019 году я начал программировать.)
2. What + подлежащее + глагол + is / was + выделяемая часть:
• What I need is a break. (Что мне нужно, так это перерыв.)
• What annoys me is the noise. (Меня раздражает именно шум.)
3. All / The thing / The reason + ... + is (that) ...:
• All I want is a quiet weekend. (Всё, чего я хочу, — это тихие выходные.)
• The reason I called is that I need your help.
• All I did was ask a question. (Я всего лишь задал вопрос.)
usage: 1. Чтобы выделить, КТО сделал: It was my manager who called me. (Именно мой менеджер мне позвонил.)
2. Чтобы выделить, ГДЕ, КОГДА или ПОЧЕМУ: It was because of the storm that we canceled the trip. (Именно из-за шторма мы отменили поездку.)
3. Чтобы выделить ЧТО: What I like about this job is the flexibility. (Что мне нравится в этой работе, так это гибкость.)
4. Чтобы поправить собеседника: It wasn't the design that I disliked, it was the price. (Мне не понравился не дизайн, а цена.)
signalWords: It was ... that / who, What ... is, All ... is, The thing is, The reason is, The problem is, The point is. Русские сигналы: «именно», «как раз», «всё, что», «вот что».
mistakes: ✗ It was Anna what fixed it → ✓ It was Anna who (или that) fixed it (what здесь не нужно)
✗ What I need it is a break → ✓ What I need is a break (не повторяем it)
✗ It were the users who found it → ✓ It was the users who found it (после It всегда was / is)
✗ What I want is that you help me → ✓ What I want is for you to help me
✗ It was yesterday when I met him → ✓ It was yesterday that I met him (для выделения времени берём that)
remember: Хочешь сказать «именно» — начни с It was ... that; хочешь сказать «что мне нужно, так это» — начни с What ... is.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте it, what, who, that, is

items.prompt: It was my manager ___ called me last night.
items.answer: who / that

items.prompt: It was in Berlin ___ we first met.
items.answer: that

items.prompt: ___ I need is a good night's sleep.
items.answer: What

items.prompt: ___ was the new update that caused the problem.
items.answer: It

items.prompt: What annoys me ___ the slow internet.
items.answer: is

items.prompt: It was last Friday ___ the server crashed.
items.answer: that

items.prompt: All I want ___ a quiet weekend.
items.answer: is

items.prompt: ___ he said surprised everyone.
items.answer: What

items.prompt: (a) It was Anna who fixed the bug. (b) It was Anna what fixed the bug.
items.answer: (a) It was Anna who fixed the bug.

items.prompt: (a) What I like is working from home. (b) What I like it is working from home.
items.answer: (a) What I like is working from home.

items.prompt: (a) It were the users who found the error. (b) It was the users who found the error.
items.answer: (b) It was the users who found the error.

items.prompt: (a) It was in 2019 that I moved to London. (b) It was in 2019 what I moved to London.
items.answer: (a) It was in 2019 that I moved to London.

items.prompt: (a) What we need are more time. (b) What we need is more time.
items.answer: (b) What we need is more time.

items.prompt: (a) The reason I'm calling is that I need your help. (b) The reason I'm calling it is that I need your help.
items.answer: (a) The reason I'm calling is that I need your help.

items.prompt: (a) All I did was ask a question. (b) All I did it was ask a question.
items.answer: (a) All I did was ask a question.

items.prompt: (a) It is the design that I don't like. (b) It is the design what I don't like.
items.answer: (a) It is the design that I don't like.

exercises.instruction: Выделите слово конструкцией It was ... that / who

items.prompt: Tom broke the printer. → It was ...
items.answer: It was Tom who broke the printer. / It was Tom that broke the printer.

items.prompt: I met her at a conference. → It was ...
items.answer: It was at a conference that I met her.

items.prompt: We launched the app in March. → It was ...
items.answer: It was in March that we launched the app.

items.prompt: The noise woke me up. → It was ...
items.answer: It was the noise that woke me up.

items.prompt: Sarah wrote this report. → It was ...
items.answer: It was Sarah who wrote this report. / It was Sarah that wrote this report.

items.prompt: I lost my phone on the train. → It was ...
items.answer: It was on the train that I lost my phone.

items.prompt: They canceled the meeting because of the storm. → It was ...
items.answer: It was because of the storm that they canceled the meeting.

items.prompt: He called me yesterday. → It was ...
items.answer: It was yesterday that he called me.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение с What ... is или All ... is

items.prompt: I need a holiday. → What ...
items.answer: What I need is a holiday.

items.prompt: The slow internet annoys me. → What ...
items.answer: What annoys me is the slow internet.

items.prompt: I want a simple answer. → What ...
items.answer: What I want is a simple answer.

items.prompt: She likes the team spirit most. → What ...
items.answer: What she likes most is the team spirit.

items.prompt: I only want a quiet place to work. → All ...
items.answer: All I want is a quiet place to work.

items.prompt: We lack time. → What ...
items.answer: What we lack is time.

items.prompt: I only closed the window. → All ...
items.answer: All I did was close the window. / All I did was to close the window.

items.prompt: I don't understand why he left. → What ...
items.answer: What I don't understand is why he left.

items.prompt: Это Анна починила принтер.
items.answer: It was Anna who fixed the printer. / It was Anna that fixed the printer.

items.prompt: Именно в Лондоне мы встретились впервые.
items.answer: It was in London that we first met. / It was in London that we met for the first time.

items.prompt: Мне сейчас нужен хороший отдых.
items.answer: What I need now is a good rest. / What I need now is a good break.

items.prompt: Меня раздражает, что встречи такие длинные.
items.answer: What annoys me is that the meetings are so long.

items.prompt: Всё, чего я хочу, — это спокойный вечер.
items.answer: All I want is a quiet evening.

items.prompt: Именно из-за этой ошибки приложение упало.
items.answer: It was because of this bug that the app crashed. / It was this bug that crashed the app.

items.prompt: Чего я не понимаю, так это почему он отказался.
items.answer: What I don't understand is why he refused.

items.prompt: Именно вчера я узнал о новой вакансии.
items.answer: It was yesterday that I found out about the new job opening. / It was yesterday that I heard about the new job opening.
